description: Source code for TaxJar integration in ERPNext, handling tax calculation, transaction creation/deletion, address validation, and error sanitization.

methods.name: get_client
methods.description: Initializes and returns a TaxJar client based on sandbox or production settings.

methods.name: create_transaction
methods.description: Creates a sales or refund transaction in TaxJar for a given document.

methods.name: delete_transaction
methods.description: Deletes an existing TaxJar order transaction.

methods.name: get_tax_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns tax calculation data based on order details and addresses.

methods.name: get_state_code
methods.description: Validates and retrieves the ISO state code for an address.

methods.name: get_line_item_dict
methods.description: Constructs a line item dictionary for tax calculation.

methods.name: set_sales_tax
methods.description: Calculates and sets sales tax on a document based on address and tax rules.

methods.name: check_for_nexus
methods.description: Checks if the order delivery region has a tax nexus; resets tax if not.

methods.name: check_sales_tax_exemption
methods.description: Determines if the customer is exempt from sales tax and adjusts accordingly.

methods.name: validate_tax_request
methods.description: Validates and retrieves tax data from TaxJar for an order.

methods.name: get_company_address_details
methods.description: Fetches the default company address details.

methods.name: get_shipping_address_details
methods.description: Fetches the shipping address details for an order.

methods.name: get_iso_3166_2_state_code
methods.description: Retrieves the ISO 3166-2 state code for an address, validating against supported states.

methods.name: sanitize_error_response
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats error messages from TaxJar responses.
